## Beyond the Scale: Modeling Anastomotic Leak as BMI Increases

This project analyzes how Body Mass Index (BMI) influences the risk of anastomotic leak following a colectomy using clinical data from 179 patients. I developed and tuned a Random Forest classification model in R to predict postoperative leak risk based on patient demographics, comorbidities, laboratory values, and surgical characteristics. The analysis included model tuning, cross-validation, and visualization of predicted risk curves for two patient case studies, demonstrating how BMI interacts with other clinical factors to affect surgical outcomes.
